PrivateUser.title: PrivateUser
PrivateUser.description: Private user account record containing PII and personal preferences, strictly isolated to the owner.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In.

readReceiptsEnabled.description: Whether read receipts are enabled for this user.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether push and in-app alert banners are enabled.

notificationPreviewEnabled.description: Whether notification alerts include sender message preview text.

onlineStatusVisible.description: Whether this user shares live online status and last seen time.

fcmTokens.description: Bounded map of per-device ID to active Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token.

blockedUserIds.description: Bounded list of user UIDs blocked by this user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when account was last updated.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public social directory profile with no PII, discoverable by signed-in users when isDiscoverable is true.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public display name shown in chats and people directory.

handle.description: Social handle (without PII) for quick discovery.

photoUrl.description: Public avatar image URL from Google profile.

statusVibe.description: Short current status note or vibe.

onlineStatusVisible.description: Whether this user allows peers to see online and last seen status.

isDiscoverable.description: Whether the profile appears in the People discovery directory.

lastHeartbeatAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest periodic foreground presence heartbeat.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

Conversation.title: Conversation
Conversation.description: Direct message or group chat conversation metadata and last-message summary.

title.description: Group channel title (empty for direct messages).

createdBy.description: UID of the user who created the conversation.

participantNames.description: Map of participant UID to display name.

participantPhotos.description: Map of participant UID to avatar URL.

lastMessageText.description: Preview text of the latest message.

lastMessageSenderId.description: UID of the latest message sender.

lastMessageSenderName.description: Display name of the latest message sender.

lastMessageType.description: Type of latest message (text, image, poll, audio).

unreadCounts.description: Map of participant UID to unread message count.

pinnedBy.description: Map of participant UID to boolean indicating pinned conversation.

mutedBy.description: Map of participant UID to boolean indicating muted notifications.

typingBy.description: Map of participant UID to server timestamp while actively typing.

recordingBy.description: Map of participant UID to server timestamp while recording a voice note.

pinnedMessageId.description: Optional pinned message ID inside the thread.

pinnedMessagePreview.description: Optional preview text of the pinned message.

pinnedMessageSenderName.description: Optional sender name of the pinned message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when conversation was updated.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Individual chat message inside a conversation with denormalized participantIds for flat rule evaluation.

participantIds.description: Denormalized participant UID list matching parent conversation.

imageBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG base64 thumbnail string.

audioBase64.description: Optional compressed AAC voice note encoded as Base64.

audioDurationSec.description: Duration in seconds of voice note attachment.

isForwarded.description: Whether this message was forwarded from another chat.

replyToSenderName.description: Optional sender name of replied message.

replyToPreview.description: Optional text preview of replied message.

reactions.description: Map of participant UID to selected emoji reaction.

pollOptions.description: Optional list of poll option labels (max 6).

pollVotes.description: Map of participant UID to chosen option index string.

isEdited.description: Whether the sender edited this message.

clientMessageId.description: Client-generated idempotency identifier matching local outbox entries.

deliveredTo.description: Map of recipient UID to delivery confirmation timestamp.

readBy.description: Map of recipient UID to read receipt confirmation timestamp.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was sent.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when message was updated.

CallSession.title: CallSession
CallSession.description: Peer-to-peer WebRTC HD voice or HD video call signaling session between two participants.

callerId.description: UID of the participant initiating the call.

participantIds.description: Exact two-element list containing callerId and calleeId.

conversationId.description: Associated conversation ID for linking back to the thread.

callType.description: Call media mode: HD voice or HD video.

qualityPreset.description: Selected HD quality target for video resolution/bitrate or 48kHz Opus voice.

status.description: Signaling lifecycle state of the call.

offerSdp.description: WebRTC SDP offer generated by caller.

answerSdp.description: WebRTC SDP answer generated by callee.

endedBy.description: UID of participant who ended or declined the call.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when call was initiated.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when call state last changed.

IceCandidate.title: IceCandidate
IceCandidate.description: Trickle ICE network candidate exchanged between call participants.

senderId.description: UID of participant sending the ICE candidate.

participantIds.description: Denormalized participant UIDs matching parent CallSession.

sdpMLineIndex.description: Zero-based index of media description in SDP.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()) when candidate was gathered.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account documents containing email and personal preferences, strictly isolated to owner.

/user_profiles/{userId}.description: Public social user profiles without PII for chat display and people discovery.

/conversations/{conversationId}.description: Direct and group chat rooms accessible strictly to participants.

/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.description: Messages belonging to a conversation, accessible strictly to participants.

/calls/{callId}.description: Active and recent WebRTC HD voice/video call signaling sessions, restricted to the two call participants.

/calls/{callId}/candidates/{candidateId}.description: Trickle ICE candidates for a WebRTC call session, readable/writable only by the two call participants.
